title: Dandelion OS Interactive Web Simulator (v4.2.0): React/TypeScript Browser Companion for Balanced Ternary Microkernel, Bite-10 Morse Bridge, Haar DWT, and Harappan Tensegrity
description: Waystation-hardened interactive React/Vite/TypeScript browser simulator visualizing the Dandelion OS balanced-ternary microkernel, Bite-10 Morse/LIS bridge, Haar DWT tremor filter, Harappan tensegrity unloading solver, Ternary Raft consensus, and deterministic verification console. Companion web simulator to leadpiperl1/dandelion-os (v5.2.0), enforced with S_runner = 0, zero npm lifecycle hooks, --ignore-scripts CI builds, 14-day Dependabot cooldown, and CODE_SHOKUNIN_UNLATCHED = 255.
